performance.cable-capacity-basis: ESTIMATE, not stated by FS - Cat6 24AWG (6.1 mm). A channel cross-section of 141.52 x 149.63 mm (21175.6 mm2) at 4.7 mm2 a cable, the figure FS's own Cat6 counts for the CMV-SFD45U5W and CMV-DFD45U5W imply, rounded down. That is FS's scale, not a packing: 4.7 mm2 is a sixth of one cable's section (see provenance `capacity`)

base.description: The steel finger duct as FS ships #220089, both sections, covers fitted.

datasheet.title: FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet (steel, portal id 6868)

description: 45U single-sided vertical cable manager, FS SKU #220089: a black SPCC steel finger duct, 2000.25 mm (45 rack units) tall in two sections, that stands beside a 45U open-frame rack on quick-release brackets bolted to the side of the upright. A steel back plate with seven openings carries a row of 44 moulded T-shaped fingers down each edge at one rack unit apart, and two detachable steel covers clip over their heads to close a channel 141.52 mm wide that runs the height of the rack. It takes no rack unit.

gaps.note: no FS document held states a cable capacity for CMV-SFDS45U5W: the steel datasheet has no capacity table (the plastic one has), and the portfolio and the guide give none. The 4505 carried is an estimate (see provenance `capacity`).
gaps.wanted: a capacity row on the product page or in a later datasheet

gaps.note: the four quick-release bracket plates bolt to the side of the duct and hook onto L-brackets on the upright; the side view draws them straddling the rear face, about 18 in front of it and 23 behind, and the guide draws them fitted on whichever side meets the upright (step 1 the left, step 3 the right). How far the duct then stands from the upright is drawn but never dimensioned. The duct is drawn without the brackets, which ship loose.

gaps.note: the drawing leaves one rack unit without a finger at one end and puts the 976.45 cover there; it is taken as the top because that is how the datasheet page stands, and no view says which end is up.

name: cmv-sfds45u5w

attrs.note: datasheet - style, sides, backbone and cover material (Steel/SPCC), colour, the detachable cover, the 45U open rack it matches and RoHS and ISO 9001 are the specification table and Standards Compliance list of the datasheet; the fixings are the product page list. The features list of the same datasheet says the part is made of ABS, copied from the plastic datasheet; the table says steel, and the renders show plastic fingers on a steel body, so the fingers are given as plastic and the body as steel.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom end is the top end again: the end view is the same at both ends.

capacity.note: estimated - FS states no cable capacity for CMV-SFDS45U5W: neither the steel datasheet nor the steel quick start guide nor the cable managers portfolio gives one. So the 4505 is worked out, not read. METHOD: the channel's inside cross-section, the `duct` guide width by the depth from the front face of the base plate to the rear face of the cover on the side view of the FS steel vertical datasheet (portal id 6868), divided by 4.7 mm2 a Cat6 cable. 4.7 is the mm2 a cable that FS's own Cat6 counts imply for CMV-SFD45U5W (12767.8 mm2 for 2745, 4.65) and CMV-DFD45U5W (two channels, 25535.6 mm2 for 5490, 4.65), rounded up to 0.1; the count is rounded down. The CMV-5U3W is not used: an open bracket with no cover has no closed channel (it implies 5.2). CROSS-SECTION: 141.52 x 149.63 = 21175.6 mm2, and 21175.6 / 4.7 = 4505.5. THE FIGURE IS FS'S SCALE, NOT A PACKING: 4.65 mm2 is a sixth of the 29.2 mm2 section of one 6.1 mm cable, so FS's vertical counts are not a fill of the channel, and this one is as far from one. It puts this part beside its sisters on the same table. The count is of Cat6 24AWG and is marked as an estimate (`cable-capacity-estimated`).

chassis.note: drawing - THE DUCT AS IT STANDS, covers fitted: `width` across the face of the rack, `height` the height it runs, `depth` front to back. 169 wide is the cover, dimensioned 169 on the cover view of both drawings; the back view measures the same 72 px at the 0.4247 px/mm of the 2000.25, and the end view draws the cover line across the same 72 px, over finger rows 160 apart outside. The specification table, the portfolio and the page title give 141.52 (5.5 in) wide: the end view of the dual dimensions 141.52 between the inner faces of the two rows, so that figure is the channel, not the part, and the single end view dimensions 145.76 across the same rows. The two renders read 159 and 164 for the cover once the turn of the camera is solved, at about five per cent; the dimensioned 169 is taken. 2000.25 high is the drawing (45 x 44.45); the table rounds it to 2000.

color.note: estimated - Color: Black. Every image FS publishes of the part is a render; it is drawn in the shades the FS horizontal steel ducts read off theirs.

cover.note: drawing - THE PART HAS A COVER, two of them. The product page gives the style as Finger Duct with no cover; the datasheet table (Finger Duct with Cover, Detachable Cover: Yes, Cover Material: Steel/SPCC), the cable managers portfolio, the cover view of the drawing, the renders (gallery images 1, 2 and 4, one cover lifted on 4) and the quick start guide step 4 (open, remove, close) all show one, so the page is wrong and the covers are drawn.

depth.note: drawing - 152.63 is the side and end views, from the back of the back plate to the front of the cover clips; the table rounds it to 152.6 (6.0 in).

fingers-shape.note: drawing - the side view draws each finger as a stem with a forked root on a block and a T-shaped head, the same moulding as the FS horizontal steel ducts; the stems measure about 10.6 and the heads about 40, and the figures of those ducts (10.2 and 39.4) are taken. The fork is drawn as the stem. The small slots along both long edges of the back view, where the blocks are fixed, are not drawn.

front.note: drawing - the covers, fitted. With them off the front is the channel between the two finger rows, the heads of the fingers end-on along each edge and the back plate with its openings behind. The rows are 9.0 thick, their inner faces 141.52 apart (the end view), so they stand 4.74 in from each edge of the 169. 44 fingers a row stand 44.45 apart, one rack unit (18.88 px on the side view); the first centre is 65.9 below the top and the last 22.4 above the bottom, so the top rack unit carries no finger, as the side view draws it, and the other 44 carry one each.

guides.note: drawing - the duct on the front view is the channel between the two finger rows, 141.52 wide, run down the height (`run: y`); its finger pitch is the 44.45 of the side view and its gap the 34.25 between stems.

left.note: drawing - the side view of the datasheet, rear at x=0: the back plate, the steel return, 44 blocks, stems and heads, the six clips and the edges of the two covers, with the joint of the return a seam. The quick-release bracket plates the side view draws are not drawn (see the bracket gap).

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet for the steel managers (portal id 6868) draws CMV-SFDS45U5W on page 3 four ways in millimetres - a side view, a cover view, a back view and an end view - laid on its side in one embedded raster (1397 x 626). Measured at native size: the side view is 849.5 px along the dimensioned 2000.25 (0.4247 px/mm) and 64.5 px across the dimensioned 152.63 (0.4226), and the cover view 72 px across the dimensioned 169 (0.426), so the views are orthographic and carry geometry to about 2.4 mm, one pixel. The steel quick start guide is a reference (steps 1, 3 and 4), and the product renders of #220089 are the second reading (gallery image 1 straight-ish, 2 the side lying down, 3 and 4 close-ups).

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`. The steel quick start guide step 3 bolts quick-release brackets to the side of the upright of a two-post rack with screws and cage nuts, eight a side, and the duct stands beside the rack, outside the rails, its fingers facing forward; step 1 draws the brackets on the side of the duct. The datasheet says it matches a 45U open rack, and the FS compatibility matrix fits it to none of the FS cabinets. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 45` is the height it runs beside. Which side of the rack is a lab placement decision (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: drawing - the back view at 0.4247 px/mm: the back plate 169 wide with seven openings on its centre line, each a declared pass-through, open, through into the channel: a 68.2 by 60 opening at the top end, five windows 150.7 long and 60 wide (60 dimensioned on the bottom one) starting 257.8, 568.6, 879.4, 1190.2 and 1501.0 from the top, and the dimensioned 150 opening at the bottom end. Six pairs of keyholes (R11 head, R6.78 slot below it) stand 311 apart, the slots ending 215.4 below the top and on, 56 apart across (dimensioned), the outer pair 1555 apart (dimensioned); six square holes about 28 stand between them. Keyholes and squares are painted; the joint is a seam.

right.note: drawing - the left view mirrored: the duct is the same on both sides.

sections.note: drawing - two sections. The cover view dimensions an upper cover 976.45 and a lower one 1021.4, the upper taken as the top as the datasheet page stands; together they leave 2.4 of the 2000.25, put at the joint between them. The back view draws the joint of the back plate at 977.2, across the middle window.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT, NOT A BOX, as every FS finger duct in the library is (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4). The body is a sheet body and its six views are elevations; the solid is what its parts build: the back plate as a well 151.43 deep, its floor open at its seven openings; two steel returns and 88 fingers standing in it; and the two covers, which pull off and open the channel. The back of the plate is built as plates sunk 0.05 inside the rear face, round the openings.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states the gauge of the SPCC; 1.2 is taken, as for the FS horizontal steel managers in the library.

top.note: drawing - the end of the duct seen from above, rear at y=0, from the side view depths: the back plate to 1.2, the steel return to 38.9, the finger block to 63.6, the stem to 142.5, the head to 149.63 and the cover sheet to 150.83, the clips to 152.63. The end view draws the rows where they are taken.

weight.note: datasheet - 9.6 kg, the FS product page specification for #220089 as read at intake; the datasheet states no weight.

guides.source: FS steel vertical datasheet (portal id 6868): the rows on the end view, the pitch on the side view
